title: I/me/my/mine
summary: Повторение: четыре типа слов — **I / me / my / mine** — и как выбрать нужное в предложении.
ru:
## Четыре формы одного «лица»
Каждому лицу соответствуют четыре слова:

| Роль | Пример |
|---|---|
| подлежащее (кто делает) | **I** know him. |
| дополнение (на кого) | He knows **me**. |
| перед существительным (чей) | That's **my** pen. |
| без существительного (чей) | That pen is **mine**. |

## Как выбрать
1. Слово **перед глаголом** и делает действие → **I, he, she, we, they**.
2. Слово **после глагола или предлога** → **me, him, her, us, them**.
3. Слово **перед существительным**, показывает «чей» → **my, his, her, our, their**.
4. Слово **само по себе**, заменяет «чей + существительное» → **mine, his, hers, ours, theirs**.

## Примеры
> 'Do you know that man?' 'Yes, I know **him**, but I can't remember **his** name.'
> — Ты знаешь этого мужчину? — Да, знаю, но не помню, как его зовут.
> She was happy because we invited **her** to stay at **our** house.
> — Она была рада, что мы пригласили её остановиться у нас дома.
> 'Is this your umbrella?' 'No, it's **yours**.'
> — Это твой зонт? — Нет, твой (= это твой, а не мой).
> He had no umbrella, so she gave **him hers**. — У него не было зонта, и она дала ему свой.

## Таблица сразу
| Подлежащее | Дополнение | Перед сущ. | Без сущ. |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | me | my | mine |
| we | us | our | ours |
| you | you | your | yours |
| he | him | his | his |
| she | her | her | hers |
| they | them | their | theirs |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~He gave a book to I.~~ → He gave a book to **me**.
- ~~They invited we.~~ → They invited **us**.
- ~~This is mine book.~~ → This is **my** book.
- ~~a friend of me~~ → a friend of **mine**.
en:
## Four words for each person
| Job in the sentence | Example |
|---|---|
| subject | **I** know him. |
| object | He knows **me**. |
| before a noun | That's **my** pen. |
| without a noun | That pen is **mine**. |

## How to choose
1. The word is before the verb and does the action → **I, he, she, we, they**.
2. The word is after a verb or a preposition → **me, him, her, us, them**.
3. The word is before a noun and says "whose" → **my, his, her, our, their**.
4. The word stands alone and replaces "whose + noun" → **mine, his, hers, ours, theirs**.

## Examples
> 'Do you know that man?' 'Yes, I know **him**, but I can't remember **his** name.'
> She was happy because we invited **her** to stay at **our** house.
> 'Is this your umbrella?' 'No, it's **yours**.'

## Common mistakes
- ~~He gave a book to I.~~ → He gave a book to **me**.
- ~~They invited we.~~ → They invited **us**.
- ~~This is mine book.~~ → This is **my** book.
- ~~a friend of me~~ → a friend of **mine**.
structure:
## Четыре колонки
| Подлежащее | Дополнение | + существительное | Самостоятельно |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | me | my | mine |
| we | us | our | ours |
| you | you | your | yours |
| he | him | his | his |
| she | her | her | hers |
| it | it | its | — |
| they | them | their | theirs |

## Формулы
> **I** + глагол + **me / him / her / them** — She loves **him**.
> **my / his / her / our / their** + существительное — **their** house
> существительное + be + **mine / yours / hers / ours / theirs** — The house is **theirs**.
> a friend **of mine / of hers / of theirs** — одна из моих (её, их) знакомых

exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужные слова: **me, him, her, us, them / my, his, her, our, their**.
exercises.example: We invited her to stay with → **us** at our house.

They invited me to stay with {{them}} at {{their}} house.

exercises.title: Замените слова
exercises.instruction: Замените выделенные слова местоимениями и допишите предложение.

items.prompt: I know Anna and Tom. → I know ___.
I gave the book to Tom. → I gave ___ the book.
This is my coat. → This coat is ___.
Kate's car is red. → ___ car is red.
We invited Sue and Pete to our party. → We invited ___ to our party.
answers: We invited them to our party.

items.prompt: Он позвонил мне, но я не знаю его номер.
answers: He called me, but I don't know his number.
He called me but I don't know his number.

items.prompt: Они пригласили нас в свой дом.
answers: They invited us to their house.
They invited us to their home.

items.prompt: Этот зонт мой, а тот твой.
answers: This umbrella is mine and that one is yours.
This umbrella is mine, and that one is yours.
This umbrella is mine, and that is yours.
This umbrella is mine and that is yours.
I met a friend of hers.

items.prompt: Мы любим наших детей, а они любят нас.
answers: We love our children and they love us.
We love our children, and they love us.
We love our kids and they love us.
We love our kids, and they love us.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите 4–5 предложений о себе и друге. Используйте **I, me, my, mine** и **he / she, him / her, his / hers**.

items.prompt: Who is your best friend? Do you know his / her family?
items.sample: My best friend is Dana. I know her family well.

items.prompt: Do you often call him / her? Does he / she call you?
items.sample: I often call her, and she calls me too.

items.prompt: Whose house do you like? Compare it with yours.
items.sample: I like my friend's house. Hers is bigger than mine.

items.prompt: Is there a friend of yours who lives far away?
items.sample: A friend of mine lives in Germany. I miss him.

items.prompt: What do you and your family like to do together?
items.sample: We like to eat together in our kitchen. It's our favourite place.
